metric_definitions.relevance: binary: query class equals gallery class
metric_definitions.precision_at_k: relevant candidates in top K / K
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: relevant candidates in top K / all relevant gallery candidates
metric_definitions.mrr_at_k: reciprocal of rank of first relevant candidate within top K, or 0
metric_definitions.ap_at_k: sum(precision at relevant ranks <= K) / min(total relevant gallery, K)
metric_definitions.map_at_k: arithmetic mean of AP@K across validation queries (macro query average)
metric_definitions.ndcg_at_k: DCG@K / IDCG@K with binary relevance and log2 discount
metric_definitions.undefined_relevance: blocked: every validation class must have at least one relevant gallery item
metric_definitions.fusion_weight: alpha=0.5 for demonstration; no parameter selection here
